# bob clipboard

Diagnose clipboard history for counted capture

```text title="bob clipboard --help"
Read the live clipboard and check whether `%c<N>` would succeed. The report includes provider health and selection details, but never prints clipboard or history contents. This command is read-only.

Usage: bob clipboard [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -c, --count <N>
          Counted clipboard values to check; minimum 2

          [default: 3]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  bob clipboard
  bob clipboard -c 5
  bob clipboard -f json

Exit codes:
  0  the counted read would succeed
  1  the counted read would refuse
  2  invalid command-line options
```
